bundle.shortDescription: DEV candidate for the XI-IO HEX local CLI installer; not a LIVE release
bundle.longDescription: Separately named development candidate of the existing HEX installer. Installs and tests only explicitly selected CLI payloads after review. Package isolation is not DEV/TEST/LIVE workspace provisioning, Ward admission, authenticated host connectivity, or permission to modify an existing LIVE installation.
